style.backgroundSystem: backgrounds cycle between a seamless snow-white studio field #FFFFFF, a rippling aqua water surface #B9D9EC and a flat glacier-blue mist field #DCE9F6, with one dim slate living-room wall #3C4A57 for the night scene and one warm taupe board #8C7368 for the closing question-and-answer screen; every information screen stays a flat matte graphic field with no photographic depth blur and no gradient falloff
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in charcoal #22303C inside rounded pill chips, one citrus-coral #F4713A marker allowed per screen, never filled or multi-coloured
style.lightingSystem: cool diffused upper-left key light with a fill card on the shadow side, single soft contact shadow grounding the housing, faint cool rim along the dark shell edges, no blown speculars, colour temperature held cool across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium countertop ice-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of snow-white studio field #FFFFFF, glacier-blue mist #DCE9F6, rippling aqua #B9D9EC, charcoal type #22303C and one citrus-coral accent #F4713A; cool colour temperature throughout; flat matte information-screen backgrounds with no gradient falloff and no depth blur; cool diffused upper-left key light with a fill card, single soft contact shadow and a faint cool rim on dark housing edges; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with wide letter spacing; thin single-weight line icons inside rounded pill chips; the same slight 3/4 product turn and locked product scale on every screen; blank unlit indicator lamps with no numerals; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no gradient falloff inside information screens
no lit display readouts or numerals
style.presentationRules: slight 3/4 turn of the same housing kept on every product-facing screen, lid open with the basket brimful of hollow ice, locked product scale between screens, indicator lamps always rendered blank and unlit
style.surfaceSystem: matte snow-white studio floor #FFFFFF, real rippling water surface #B9D9EC, frosted glacier snow field #DCE9F6, pale round side table and white slatted outdoor table as the only lifestyle surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, wide letter-spaced headline over one short supporting line, all wording carried only by placeholders so any real product copy can be dropped in
